sql.value: SELECT t.*, sum(t.depreciation_credit) AS current, (SELECT sum(ffad2.depreciation_credit) FROM fxy_financial_assets_detail ffad2 WHERE ffad2.assert_id = t.assert_id AND ffad2.depreciation_id is not null AND ffad2.check_date BETWEEN date_format(t.check_date, '%Y-01-01') AND t.check_date AND ffad2.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId) AS currentYear, t.original_value - t.net_value AS total FROM (SELECT date_format(ffad.check_date, '%Y年%m月') AS MONTH, ffad.assert_id, ffad.check_date, ffd.name as dept_name, ffa.CODE, ffa.NAME, ffat.NAME AS typeName, ffa.specification, ffa.original_value, ffad.net_value, ffad.depreciation_credit FROM fxy_financial_assets_detail ffad LEFT JOIN fxy_financial_assets ffa ON ffad.assert_id = ffa.id AND ffad.account_sets_id = ffa.account_sets_id LEFT JOIN fxy_financial_department ffd ON ffd.id = ffa.dept_id AND ffd.account_sets_id = ffa.account_sets_id LEFT JOIN fxy_financial_assets_type ffat ON ffa.assets_type_id = ffat.id AND ffat.account_sets_id = ffa.account_sets_id where ffad.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffad.depreciation_id is not null and ffad.check_date between :start and :end #[and ffa.assets_type_id = :assetsTypeId] #[and ffa.code = :code] #[and ffad.dept_id = :deptId] ) t group by t.check_date,t.code,t.assert_id,t.net_value,t.depreciation_credit order by t.check_date, t.code

select tt.*, coalesce(tt.originalStart, 0) + coalesce(tt.original_credit, 0) - coalesce(tt.original_debit, 0) as originalLast, coalesce(tt.depreciationStart, 0) + coalesce(tt.depreciation_debit, 0) - coalesce(tt.depreciation_credit, 0) as depreciationLast, coalesce(tt.impairmentStart, 0) + coalesce(tt.impairment_debit, 0) - coalesce(tt.impairment_credit, 0) as impairmentLast from (select sum(t.original_credit) AS original_debit, sum(t.original_debit) AS original_credit, sum(t.depreciation_credit) as depreciation_debit, sum(t.depreciation_debit) as depreciation_credit, sum(t.impairment_debit) as impairment_credit, sum(t.impairment_credit) as impairment_debit, (select sum(ffad2.original_debit - ffad2.original_credit) from fxy_financial_assets_detail ffad2 where ffad2.dept_id = t.dept_id and ffad2.check_date < :start and ffad2.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId) as originalStart, (select sum(ffad3.depreciation_credit - ffad3.depreciation_debit) from fxy_financial_assets_detail ffad3 where ffad3.dept_id = t.dept_id and ffad3.check_date < :start and ffad3.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId) as depreciationStart, (select sum(ffad4.impairment_debit - ffad4.impairment_credit) from fxy_financial_assets_detail ffad4 where ffad4.dept_id = t.dept_id and ffad4.check_date < :start and ffad4.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId) as impairmentStart, t.deptName as name, t.dept_id as dept_id from (select ffad.*, ffat.name typeName, ffd.`name` deptName, ffa.assets_type_id from fxy_financial_assets_detail ffad LEFT JOIN fxy_financial_department ffd ON ffad.dept_id = ffd.id AND ffad.account_sets_id = ffd.account_sets_id left join fxy_financial_assets ffa on ffad.assert_id = ffa.id and ffad.account_sets_id = ffa.account_sets_id left join fxy_financial_assets_type ffat on ffa.assets_type_id = ffat.id and ffat.account_sets_id = ffa.account_sets_id where ffad.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffad.check_date between :start and :end) t group by t.dept_id order by t.dept_id) tt

select tt.*, coalesce(tt.originalStart, 0) + coalesce(tt.original_credit, 0) - coalesce(tt.original_debit, 0) as originalLast, coalesce(tt.depreciationStart, 0) + coalesce(tt.depreciation_debit, 0) - coalesce(tt.depreciation_credit, 0) as depreciationLast, coalesce(tt.impairmentStart, 0) + coalesce(tt.impairment_debit, 0) - coalesce(tt.impairment_credit, 0) as impairmentLast from (select sum(t.original_credit) as original_debit, sum(t.original_debit) as original_credit, sum(t.depreciation_credit) as depreciation_debit, sum(t.depreciation_debit) as depreciation_credit, sum(t.impairment_debit) as impairment_credit, sum(t.impairment_credit) as impairment_debit, (select sum(ffad2.original_debit - ffad2.original_credit) from fxy_financial_assets_detail ffad2 left join fxy_financial_assets f on ffad2.assert_id = f.id where f.assets_type_id = t.assets_type_id and ffad2.check_date < :start and ffad2.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId) as originalStart, (select sum(ffad3.depreciation_credit - ffad3.depreciation_debit) from fxy_financial_assets_detail ffad3 left join fxy_financial_assets f on ffad3.assert_id = f.id where f.assets_type_id = t.assets_type_id and ffad3.check_date < :start and ffad3.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId) as depreciationStart, (select sum(ffad4.impairment_debit - ffad4.impairment_credit) from fxy_financial_assets_detail ffad4 left join fxy_financial_assets f on ffad4.assert_id = f.id where f.assets_type_id = t.assets_type_id and ffad4.check_date < :start and ffad4.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId) as impairmentStart, t.typeName as name, t.assets_type_id as assets_type_id from (select ffad.*, ffat.name typeName, ffa.assets_type_id from fxy_financial_assets_detail ffad left join fxy_financial_assets ffa on ffad.assert_id = ffa.id and ffad.account_sets_id = ffa.account_sets_id left join fxy_financial_assets_type ffat on ffa.assets_type_id = ffat.id and ffat.account_sets_id = ffa.account_sets_id where ffad.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffad.check_date between :start and :end) t group by t.assets_type_id order by t.assets_type_id) tt
